Senses.Explanation: The wielding pair: release and seize, kill and give life — the old teachers had it in both hands. Zhaozhou read it in two raised fists, bowing to one and faulting the other; Manjusri himself stops at the rankless true person. The fist case and the stopped hand: Feiyin Tongrong raises Zhaozhou at the hermitage doors — have it? have it? — one hermit raises a fist and Zhaozhou reads him as churning water, no place to moor, and walks; the next hermit raises the same fist and Zhaozhou bows — can release and can seize, can kill and can give life — and Feiyin presses: one praise, one blame, heaven-and-deep apart, where is the mix-up?; Hanyue Fazang gives the same case and sifts it — sand washed, the grit stays behind; chaff winnowed, the husks ride in front — the two stone gate-leaves shut like iron: who knocks at the cold smoke of midnight?; Dahui Zonggao stops even Manjusri: Sudhana good at gathering the herb, Manjusri good at using the herb — yet meet the rankless true person and one can neither kill him nor give him life; grant the killing and the quickening: how would Manjusri lay a hand on the rankless true person's share? The hand at work: Linye Tongqi credits the old teachers with deep strategy — can seize, can release, can kill, can give life — and claims for himself no such skill, only the one talent of ungluing and unbinding; Yinyuan Longqi opens the new year under the royal writ — within it the provisional and the real, the shining and the working, can release and can seize, can kill and can give life — master them one by one and you are fit to enter the Huangbo chamber; Eryin Mi builds it into means: pivot clear, one is high and low, big and small, all interfused; means at hand, one releases and seizes, kills and gives life, free in both — and only such means make the great show in the small and the one hold the measureless; Daxiu Zhu brands it in blood at the instruction — gather and release, whip-rope in hand, can kill and can give life, fresh blood dripping — such a one can eat the buddha's rice, wear the buddha's robe, take the buddha's precepts and curse the buddha; Yuan'an Liao, run through the schema of the princes and asked which is the transformation-born prince, answers: can kill and can give life.
